working_definition: P15 cluster containing cells from classes 31 (Mi15), 128 (Dm2), 129 and 138; the authors' call is 'probably immature neurons of classes 31 (Mi15)/128 (Dm2)/129/138' (no tail described).
searches_performed: immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that develops from an optic neuroblast and will become an adult optic lobe neuron.

justification: Immature Mi15 (FBbt:00052318) and immature Dm2 (FBbt:00052309) are both immature adult optic lobe neurons; classes 129 and 138 are unnamed, so the optic-lobe-neuron level is the safe common parent. Verification flagged because of the authors' 'probably' hedge.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the medullary intrinsic neuron Mi15 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the D/BarHI temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

other_candidates.fbbt_term: immature distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm2
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm2 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the D/BarHI temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

recommendation: Broad match to immature adult optic lobe neuron; members Mi15, Dm2 and two unnamed classes.
